requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 使用 TM1637 + DHT11（D7）：显示温度，每 2 秒刷新
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Provide DHT11 temperature samples on io_0 at least 2s apart; example trace: set io_0 to 25.4 then after >2s set to 26.9, and observe each corresponding io_1 update.
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: io_1 equals floor(io_0) for each sampled update (e.g., 25.4 -> 25, 26.9 -> 26), with no dependence on any elapsed-time input in the controller.
